notes.title: Full Version | Now Available on console! 💚
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Horse Lovers! 🐴[/b][/h1]

[h3]I[b]t’s time to expand and discover new horizons on consoles! 💚 [/b]

We’re proud to announce that [b]our game has just been released on Xbox Series X|S! 🥳🎉[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Direct link to the game on Xbox 👇 Optimized for Xbox Series X|S 🎮[/b][/h3]
https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/my-horse-bonded-spirits/9plfrcqhd9p4


[url=https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/my-horse-bonded-spirits/9plfrcqhd9p4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/2a4d690e174fe1e4c2db95d60b0e0d8996b13d0b.png[/img][/url]

[h3][b]Once again you can dive into the amazing world of horse-riding adventures and live through all those breath-taking memories on consoles! 😊[/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=0NH3hivKuD8;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://discord.gg/amfcqNcaqD][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/5e1658377feffb2a5803c32d094ac01188c7324b.png[/img][/url]

Have fun!
My Horse: Bonded Spirits Team

notes.title: Prologue Released! 🥳
notes.content:
[h2][b]We are thrilled to announce that the gates to new adventure are now wide open for everyone! 🐴[/b][/h2]

[h1][b]The free Prologue of My Horse: Bonded Spirits is now available for play! 👇 🥳[/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2626970/My_Horse_Bonded_Spirits__Prologue/

Now each of you can start your own adventure in the free Prologue to My Horse: Bonded Spirits. 🐴 This is just a foretaste of what awaits you in the full version of the game. 😍

We are looking forward to your opinions, feedback, and ideas, which are crucial in the further development of the full version of the game. We really count on your feedback, you can do it on Community Hub or on our Discord, links are below 👇

📖 | [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2626970/discussions/0/4293691486114753099/]PROLOGUE - SUGGESTIONS & FEEDBACK[/url]
🐛 | [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2626970/discussions/0/4293691486114752368/]PROLOGUE - BUGS & PROBLEMS[/url]
💬 | [url=https://discord.gg/amfcqNcaqD]Discord [/url]

To start your own adventure, all you need to do is go to the Prologue Steam page and download the game, it is completely free and available to everyone - start your adventure now! 🤩

[b]We can't wait to hear your opinions! 😊[/b]

[previewyoutube=lfVEeVHAMJg;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://discord.gg/amfcqNcaqD][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43952660/5e1658377feffb2a5803c32d094ac01188c7324b.png[/img][/url] 

Have fun!
My Horse: Bonded Spirits Team
